<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/sites"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Adds a Site to the warehouse map. The site code becomes the first segment of every LocationCode inside the facility, so it must be uppercase alphanumeric and unique across the service. Site code uniqueness is enforced here in the application layer rather than in the aggregate: a single aggregate cannot see its siblings. A newly registered Site is Active, and publishes SiteRegistered.

`siteRole` (ADR-0037) is optional: omitted means `UNSPECIFIED`. An unknown role is 422 `invalid-site-role`. The role never sets the transfer capability (ADR-0035 stays the only writer; see `GET /site-roles/transfer-defaults` for the per-role defaults).

  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit) that makes a retried request safe (ADR 0019). Clients MUST always send a non-empty, unique-per-submit key: the service runs on Postgres in every deployment (ADR 0039), so the header is always enforced and an absent or empty key is answered 400 `idempotency-key-required`. A replay with the same key and the same body returns the original response verbatim; the same key with a different body is 422 `idempotency-key-reused`.","schema":{"type":"string","example":"5b0f6a0e-6a41-4c63-9f33-0c8f5c1d2a77"}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
